symbols.read: The prior short is dead: price reclaimed 722.40 and pushed to 731.72, so the SELL signal is invalidated and the combined stance has downgraded to HOLD rather than a clean flip long. The 1H trend has turned up with the last candle closing +0.54%, and the new bullish FVG at 719.67–728.71 now sits beneath price as support, while the 734.5–735.01 bearish FVG remains the immediate overhead supply. Bias is neutral-to-constructive while price holds above 728.71, with a break under that zone reviving the bearish case toward 722.40 and the 686.36 target. Invalidation of the current hold is a sustained reclaim of 737.02, which would confirm the bullish regime and open the 758.44 upper pivot.

Price has reclaimed the 81,033.66 lower pivot and pushed to 82,230.01, invalidating the prior short read — the bear FVG at 81,189.67–81,208.00 has been consumed and the 1H trend has flipped up (81,872.27→82,418.00). Combined 4H+1H now reads HOLD rather than SELL, with 4H still bearish but the 1H up-trend overriding; the BULLISH regime is no longer a lone conflicting signal. Bias is neutral-to-constructive above 81,033.66, with the bear FVG at 83,102.73–83,338.00 as overhead supply and the bull FVG at 80,772.98–81,755.01 as support. A loss of 81,033.66 revives the short toward 77,715.32; a clean break of 83,338.00 opens the 84,352.00 upper pivot.

The SELL from 2,403.69 is now invalidated: price at 2,434.67 has pushed above the 2,417.54 invalidation level and reclaimed the 2,403.69 pivot, flipping the 1H trend up with a +1.85% candle from 2,396.40 to 2,440.64. The combined 4H+1H read has downgraded to HOLD, with the 4H still bearish against the 1H upswing — a conflict, not a clean reversal. Two bear FVGs now sit overhead at 2,457.22–2,474.79 and 2,487.49–2,500.41, giving the first supply shelves to lean on, while 2,579.88 remains the structural flip to bullish. Bias is neutral-to-cautious-long into those FVGs; a rejection there revives the bearish case, but a sustained push through 2,579.88 confirms the BULLISH regime and kills the short thesis outright.

Price has advanced to 105.75 and is now testing the 107.16 lower pivot from below, with the 1H trend up and a fresh +1.20% candle (104.82→106.08) pressing directly into a new bearish FVG at 106.49–106.66 — the opposite condition from the prior read, where the gap had been absorbed and no FVGs remained. The bias stays neutral-to-bearish on the 4H only, but the short is now closer to triggering than at any point in the prior read: a rejection at the 106.49–106.66 FVG keeps 107.16 as the level that restores the SELL toward 100.92. The invalidation is unchanged — a 4H close above 107.16 kills the bearish structure, with 113.40 the hard cap. What changed versus the prior read: price reclaimed the 103.38–103.94 zone entirely and pushed ~2.5 points higher, so the downside path to 100.92 now requires a fresh breakdown rather than continuation, and the BULLISH regime flag is again in tension with the 4H bearish direction.

Bias stays bearish and the setup has firmed back up: the 4H+1H combined signal flipped from HOLD to SELL, and price at 57.04 is now pressing directly into the 57.473–58.374 bearish FVG with the 1H trend down and the last 1H candle rolling over (-0.13%). The short-on-rejection zone remains the actionable structure, with entry 58.41, stop 58.58, and target 55.37, while the lower pivot at 58.41 sits just below the FVG top — a sustained push through 58.41 without rejection would confirm the bearish read is failing. Invalidation is a reclaim of the 61.45 upper pivot.

Price at 4,149.85 has extended the hold above the 4,141.44 lower pivot, confirming the prior read's neutral-to-cautious stance — the 1H trend remains up and the bearish 4H case is still not reversed. The only open FVG remains the bull shelf at 4,090.79–4,092.755, so no overhead bearish gap caps upside and the path toward the 4,217.40 upper pivot stays open while 4,141.44 holds. The SELL setup stays invalidated, and with 4H direction still bearish against a rising 1H, the combined read remains HOLD rather than a fresh long. Invalidation: a sustained break back below 4,141.44 re-arms the bearish 4H case toward the 4,065.48 target; a clean hold keeps the upside bias intact.

The prior HOLD with a neutral-to-long lean has played out: price advanced from 1.31 to 1.34 (+1.09% on the last 1H), the 1H trend has flipped up, and the 1.353–1.3567 bear FVG is now the immediate overhead test rather than a distant level. The prior short from 1.31 remains dead — the new SELL tag is already marked INVALIDATED — and the bullish regime is intact, so bias stays neutral-to-long while 1.31 holds. A push through 1.353–1.3567 opens the 1.3668–1.3704 bear gap, with 1.43 the upper pivot that would confirm the regime shift; losing 1.31 revives the 1.20 target and re-arms the short with 1.37 as stop.
